requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

weight_management_program.text:
A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 38.2 — starting today:
 - Reduced-calorie meal plan of about 1400 kcal/day with food logging in a phone app.
 - Brisk walking with a coworker at lunch, 5 days a week.
 - Enrolling in employer-sponsored weight management program with monthly coaching; RD visit through program.
 Follow-up in ~3–4 months.
2. Hypertension — BP 142/86 on lisinopril 10 mg daily; continue for now, home readings.
3. A1c 6.2% — prediabetes range. Reviewed meaning; recheck A1c in 6 months.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 02/03/2026
Employer program RD intake. Food log: drive-through lunch daily, sweetened coffee drinks, desserts most evenings, large portions at dinner.
Plan: ~1400 kcal/day logged in app; pack lunch 4 days/week; unsweetened coffee; dessert 2x/week, portioned; reduce refined carbs given prediabetes, add fiber.
Activity: brisk lunchtime walking with coworker 5 days/week.
Monthly coaching + RD follow-up in 6 weeks.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 05/12/2026
S: Follow-up. Continues the meal plan and lunchtime walks started in January; logging in app most days, packing lunch, cut sweetened coffee. Monthly coaching calls. Reports good adherence most weeks.
O: Wt 99.7 kg, BMI 37.5. BP 142/82.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/20/2026
S: Follow-up. Continues the diet and exercise plan and program follow-ups since January. Walking 5 days a week, logging meals. Frustrated — weight 98.6 kg today vs 101.5 kg when the plan began in January (-2.9%), little change since May despite reported adherence. Worried about diabetes. Asks about medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis.
O: Wt 98.6 kg, BMI 37.1. BP 130/85.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 37.1 — plateau on lifestyle program. Start semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly (Wegovy) with standard dose titration; counseled on GI side effects. Continue diet and walking. Recheck in 3 months.
2. Hypertension — BP 130/85 on lisinopril 10 mg daily; improved; continue.
3. A1c 6.2% — prediabetes range; recheck A1c at next visit.

no_concurrent_glp1.text:
URGENT CARE — 09/26/2024
47 y/o M with cough, chest tightness, and wheeze that begin ~10 minutes into his early-morning jogs now that the weather has turned cold; resolve 20–30 min after stopping. No symptoms at rest, no chest pain, no fever. No hx asthma.
Exam: SpO2 98%, lungs clear at rest, HR 82, BP 140/88.
Assessment: exercise-induced bronchospasm.
Plan: albuterol 2 puffs 15 min before running; warm up gradually; cover mouth in cold air. PCP follow-up for BP recheck.

TELEPHONE ENCOUNTER — 01/25/2025
Refill request: cetirizine 10 mg for year-round allergic rhinitis. Last filled 3 months ago. 90-day supply sent to pharmacy. No new symptoms.
